import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 查看战斗过程
 * 指令：查看战斗过程 [战斗日志ID]
 */

import App from '@src/response-apps/battle/viewLog/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { BattleFormatGui } from '@src/utils/battleMemoryMessage';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const regex = /^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?查看战斗过程\s+(.+)$/;
  const messageText = e.MessageText ?? '';
  const match = messageText.match(regex);

  if (!match) {
    return;
  }

  const logId = String(match[2]).trim();
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  const result = await App({ bid, uid, logId, messageText, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  switch (result.code) {
    case 'MISSING_ID':
      md.addText('请提供战斗日志ID');

      break;
    case 'NOT_FOUND':
      md.addText(result.data.message);

      break;
    case 'FAIL':
      md.addText(result.data.message);

      break;
    case 'MEMORY_ONLY':
      md.addText('此记录可在战斗回忆中查看。');
      void message.send(await BattleFormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '战斗回忆', content: md }, [{ id: logId }]));

      return;
    case 'OK':
      md.addCode(result.data.log, { language: 'markdown' });
      void message.send(await BattleFormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '战斗过程', content: md }, [{ id: logId }]));

      return;
  }

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
});
